name: J. Roy Rowland
summary: James Roy Rowland Jr. (February 3, 1926 – April 25, 2022) was an American World War II veteran, politician, and physician from the U.S. state of Georgia who served as a member of the Georgia House of Representatives from the 119th district from 1976 to 1982 and as a member of the United States House of Representatives for six terms representing Georgia's 8th congressional district from 1983 to 1995.
